basic_details.job_title: ILBS Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 8 Research Assistant/Clinical Coordinator, AI/ML Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS) has announced 8 project-based vacancies for Signal Processing Engineer (Breath/Speech), Bio Medical Data Scientist, Senior AI/ML Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, Clinical Research Nurse Coordinator, Research Assistant/Clinical Coordinator, and Embedded Hardware & Firmware Engineer posts. Eligible candidates can attend a walk-in interview on 31 October 2026, reporting by 11:00 AM at MPH-II, First Floor, Phase-II, ILBS. B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with minimum 3 years of relevant R&D/industry experience in medical device development or calibration; OR M.E./M.Tech./M.S. with minimum 1 year of relevant experience; OR Ph.D. in Engineering/Technology/Science with relevant doctoral research in medical device development or calibration.

content_sections.heading: ILBS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop predictive algorithms for breath/speech biomarkers. Train and validate ML models using 3D/breath/speech data. Collaborate with clinicians for data interpretation. Evaluate and set up body and retinal scanners. Analyze patient health parameters, imaging, and biomarkers using advanced statistical and ML models. Ensure medical validity of results. Collaborate with software developers for device communication. Build and optimize AI models integrating medical imaging, speech, and clinical data. Mentor junior engineers and ensure quality of research output. Implement secure data handling and interoperability protocols. Develop predictive algorithms for NCD screening. Train and validate ML models using 3D and retinal data. Collaborate with clinicians for data interpretation. Conduct imaging sessions, collect subject data. Ensure standardization and quality control. Coordinate clinical research activities, patient assessments, and ensure ethical compliance in data collection and validation. Support population-based surveys and follow-up. Design and develop embedded biomedical/wearable devices. Develop firmware and integrate biomedical sensors. Design, assemble and test PCB prototypes. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must report for the walk-in interview with the following items: Duly filled-in application form in the prescribed format appended with the notification. A recent passport-size photograph affixed on the application form. All required original documents supporting educational qualifications, date of birth, experience, and category/disability claims. One set of self-attested photocopies of all required documents as per Recruitment Rules (RRs).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at MPH-II, First Floor, Phase-II, ILBS on or before 11:00 AM on 31 October 2026. Document verification and attendance will take place upon reporting. In the event of a large number of candidates reporting, the Institute reserves the right to undertake further screening based on qualifications and experience and to shortlist candidates for conducting a written test and/or interview, as deemed appropriate.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must report on or before 11:00 AM on 31 October 2026, after which no candidate will be permitted to appear for the walk-in interview. The engagement is purely contractual till 31 December 2026 and co-terminus with the project duration; selected candidates have no claim for regular appointment at ILBS or continuation in any other project. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or any related selection process. Applications submitted in any other format, or incomplete, unsigned applications, or applications without requisite documents shall lead to disqualification. No other benefits such as HRA, Provident Fund, CCA, Leave Travel Concession, or Medical Claims shall be admissible. Any form of canvassing or attempt to influence the selection process will result in immediate disqualification. The Institute reserves the right to cancel or modify the walk-in interview / advertised positions without assigning any reason. For queries, candidates can contact: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the ILBS Recruitment 2026 walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 31 October 2026 (Saturday) at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report on or before 11:00 AM at MPH-II, First Floor, Phase-II, ILBS.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are advertised under ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8 project-based vacancies across 7 different posts are advertised in this notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the tenure of the posts in ILBS?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis till 31 December 2026 and co-terminus with the project tenure.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration ranges from ₹55,000/- consolidated per month up to ₹1,50,000/- per month depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for Research Assistant and Embedded Engineer, 38 years for AI/ML Engineer, and 40 years for the other posts as on the closing date.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances like HRA or Medical Claims admissible?
faq.answer: No, additional benefits such as HRA, Provident Fund, CCA, Leave Travel Concession, or Medical Claims are not admissible.

faq.question: Q8. Will any TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or any related selection process.

faq.question: Q9. What selection method will be followed if many candidates report?
faq.answer: In the event of a large number of candidates, ILBS reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on qualifications and experience and conduct a written test and/or interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the duly filled prescribed application form with a photograph affixed, along with original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.
